story: At the world's loudest birthday party, a normally shy penguin named Gregor turned wildly GREGARIOUS, hugging all two hundred guests in a glowing neon-pink tuxedo. The CACOPHONY of those two hundred kazoos was so deafening it shook the cake. Above the chaos, a giant soap bubble of EPHEMERAL rainbow light swelled, sparkled for exactly one heartbreaking second, then popped. Just then a sneaky purple octopus tried to OBFUSCATE the cake by squirting ink everywhere, smearing the candles into a foggy blur. The whole scene was such a joyful, ridiculous ABERRATION from any normal party that the guests laughed until they cried.

placements.where: upper-right, translucent iridescent letters dissolving at the edges

placements.object: a tilted neon banner strung above the whole party

image_prompt: A vivid, exaggerated cartoon illustration of the world's loudest birthday party, hyper-saturated colors, joyful chaotic energy. A grinning penguin in a glowing neon-pink tuxedo hugs a crowd of 200 guests; render the word "GREGARIOUS" in bold yellow letters across the sash on its chest (center-left). A towering pile of 200 kazoos blasts cartoon soundwaves; a hand-painted sign staked in the pile reads "CACOPHONY" in jagged red letters (lower-left). A huge rainbow soap bubble bursts in the upper-right with translucent iridescent letters dissolving at its edges that spell "EPHEMERAL". A purple octopus squirts ink over the cake, and the smoky ink itself forms the word "OBFUSCATE" in half-hidden purple letters (center-right). A crooked neon banner across the top of the frame glows hot-pink and reads "ABERRATION". Render every word as large, legible, correctly spelled text exactly as given, integrated naturally into each object. Style: bright children's-book cartoon meets pop-art poster, thick outlines, dramatic emotion, exaggerated proportions.
